subject: Status + unblock: owner batch acknowledged, re-mint RUNNING now, #1031/#1037 refreshed and MERGEABLE, #1019 has four conflict files (yours) — recipe inside

Recipe that worked for mine: merge Alpha in, take mainline's copy of each and re-append your sections (DR-054 last), regenerate the coverage page, run preflight. Nothing is waiting on the owner: the only owner-reserved call (the DR-056 attestation) does not gate any merge or any work.
